description: Gravl connects your Gravl workout tracking account to ChatGPT. Review your training history, personal records, exercise progress, weekly training summaries, strength scores, and body measurements. Build workout templates and custom splits from Gravl's exercise library, log completed workouts from a description, and update goals, equipment, units, rest times, and other training settings. Changes sync to the Gravl app. A Gravl account is required, and the app only acts on the signed-in user's own data.

defaultPrompt: How did my training go over the last 4 weeks?
